title: Fixed promos switch from cents to dollars

agents.task: Change fixed promos so that Promo.value for kind "fixed" is whole dollars instead of cents: applyDiscount in src/discount.ts must multiply it by 100. Update the comment on Promo in src/types.ts and every existing test that uses a fixed promo. You own src/discount.ts, src/types.ts and the existing tests.

Add src/promos.ts exporting PROMOS: Record<string, Promo> with a WELCOME5 promo (kind "fixed", $5 off, i.e. 500 cents) and findPromo(code: string): Promo | undefined (case-insensitive). Add tests in test/promos.test.ts, including: calculateTotal of a $20 cart with WELCOME5 is $15. You own src/promos.ts and test/promos.test.ts; do not edit other files.

notes: Units conflict: after A, WELCOME5 with value 500 means $500 off and the $20 cart totals $0. Correct merge: WELCOME5 value 5.
